takeaways.title: `MeterLevel` has a new `over` level
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `MeterLevel` now includes `over`, so add an `over` key to any `Record<MeterLevel, …>` in your app, and stop relying on `ShareSegment.color`, which is now optional and ignored.

takeaways.title: One colour scale for every usage meter
takeaways.body: `meterLevel` and `usageLevel` now return `ok` under 75%, `watch` (amber) from 75%, `alert` (orange) from 90% and `over` (red) from 100%, so all meters in your app agree.

takeaways.title: Health meters
takeaways.body: Meters now take `kind="health"` and use the new `healthLevel` helper and `HEALTH_LEVELS` bands (green at 99% and over, amber from 95%, red below 95%), which you can override with `configureLumen({ healthLevels })`.

takeaways.title: `ShareMeter` shows usage past the cap
takeaways.body: Past 100% the bar stays full and a hatched stub spills past a tick at the cap (up to +50%), and the bar keeps its level colour instead of the segment label colours that made a 111% bar look green and a 9% bar look red.

takeaways.title: Theme tokens for meter colours
takeaways.body: Use the new `--meter-ok`, `--meter-watch`, `--meter-alert` and `--meter-over` tokens (light and dark), plus `--caution` for `UnitValue tone="caution"`, to match your own UI to the meters.

takeaways.title: Tables never hide columns to fit
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `LumenTable` (and so `LumenView` tables) now shows every column at every width, so a table wider than its room scrolls sideways instead of dropping its lowest-priority columns.

takeaways.title: The name column keeps a steady width
takeaways.body: In `LumenTable`, the name column now stays at `--lead-col-max` instead of growing into freed space, so the other columns keep their room when the sidebar or a docked drawer is open.

takeaways.title: `ViewField.priority` is deprecated
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ui-types`, `ViewField.priority` is still accepted so your types keep compiling, but it is now ignored, and you can remove it from your view definitions.

takeaways.title: `InfoTip` is easier to tap
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, the `InfoTip` icon is still drawn at 16px but now has a 24px hit area, so setting help passes phone tap-target checks.

takeaways.title: Row budgets for every call, wake and day
takeaways.body: In lumen-person, the new `RowBudget` counts each SQL statement's own `rowsRead` and `rowsWritten` and enforces limits per call (100k read, 20k written), per wake (200k read, 20k written) and per store per UTC day (600k read, 12k written), so one runaway page can no longer use up the whole day's quota.

takeaways.title: Outside brake
takeaways.body: Send `_object.brake` with `{ level }` set to `background` or `stop` to slow or halt a store from outside, for example when the whole account nears its cap, and read today's totals with `_object.budget`, both of which still answer after the day's budget is spent.

takeaways.title: Alert when a limit is hit
takeaways.body: Pass `onLimit` to `RowBudget` and it fires once per level per day, so your app can send an alert when a budget is crossed.

takeaways.title: `PersonObject` is metered
takeaways.body: `PersonObject` now meters its own SQL, scopes each call and wake, and accepts a `budget` in its deps, so you can tune the limits per app.

takeaways.title: Inline view callbacks no longer re-fire every render
takeaways.body: In `LumenLayout`, `onTokens` and `paging.onSort` now run only when their value changes, and in `LumenView`, `groups.onGroup` does the same, so passing an inline function no longer loops renders or asks the server for the same page repeatedly.

takeaways.title: `useTell` hook
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `useTell` runs a callback when its value changes, never because the callback is a new function, and compares values by JSON.

takeaways.title: Facets listed without counts
takeaways.body: In `FacetCounts` from `@columenlabs/lumen-ui-types`, the new optional `counted: false` makes the filter box and filter panel list a field's values with no numbers, for fields a server can't count without reading every row.

takeaways.title: Check whether counts are shown
takeaways.body: `countsShown(filter, key?)` from `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` now accepts a field key and tells you whether that field's counts are displayed; without a key it behaves as before.

takeaways.title: Calendar part with Month, Week and Agenda views
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, the new `LumenCalendar` takes plain `events` (`{id, title, start, end?, allDay?, category?, color?}`) and optional `categories`, and you can react with `onSelect` and `onRangeChange`.

takeaways.title: Kanban-style board part
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, the new `LumenBoard` takes `columns` and `items` (each item points at a column by `column`), and you can customize cards with `renderCard` and handle `onOpen` and `onMove`.

takeaways.title: Player part
takeaways.body: `LumenPlayer` is now exported from `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` next to the calendar and board, so you can add it to an app without writing your own.

takeaways.title: No new dependencies
takeaways.body: `LumenCalendar` works out days in the `timeZone` you pass (the browser's by default) using `Intl`, so you don't need a date library.

takeaways.title: Filter as a side panel of facets
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, the new `LumenFilterPanel` draws a filter as a panel of each field's values, ticked in place with counts, beside a list, and `LumenFilterPanelButton` and `useFilterPanel` let you place and control its toggle.

takeaways.title: Panel and chips stay in sync
takeaways.body: `LumenFilterPanel` reads and writes the same `useLumenFilter` tokens as `LumenTokenizedFilter`, so ticking a value adds a chip and removing a chip unticks the value, with no second filter state to manage.

takeaways.title: Count every row, not just the loaded page
takeaways.body: `useLumenFilter({ facets })` now accepts the server's counts (`FacetCounts`) for paged rows, so both the filter box and the panel can show counts for all rows.

takeaways.title: Panel wired into the page layout
takeaways.body: In `LumenLayout`, the new `facets` prop and `filterPanel={{ id, tips, order, title }}` option place the panel beside the page's scroller, with its icon in the filter row.

takeaways.title: Shared facet counting
takeaways.body: `useFacetCounts(filter)` is now exported, so your own filter UI can reuse the counting the filter box already did.

takeaways.title: Setting help moves into an InfoTip
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `SettingRow` now shows its `description` behind an `InfoTip` (i) beside the label instead of as a grey line under the row, so your settings rows are more compact with no code change.

takeaways.title: Lint catches a standalone settings page
takeaways.body: `lumen-ship check parts` has a new `settings-page` rule that fails any route, link or nav item (`path`, `to` or `href`) pointing to a page named `settings`, so move that content into sections of the one Settings dialog (`?settings=<section>`).

takeaways.title: Help text stays searchable
takeaways.body: A `SettingRow` `description` is still matched by settings search even though it now sits behind the `InfoTip`, so people can still find a setting by its help text.

takeaways.title: Mark assistant tool groups as read-only
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ai`, set the new `readOnly` option on a `ToolGroup` that has no write tools, and its status reports `drafts` and `writes` as false.

takeaways.title: Settings ▸ Tools no longer offers a useless Read + draft choice
takeaways.body: In `AssistantSettings`, a group with `readOnly` set now shows only Off and Read, where it used to show Read + draft even though picking it did nothing.

takeaways.title: Saved write levels on read-only groups read as Read
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ai`, a saved Read + draft or Read + write value on a `readOnly` tool group is now treated as Read, so older saved settings still display correctly.

takeaways.title: `drafts` is documented on assistant status groups
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui-types`, `AssistantStatus.groups[].drafts` now has documentation, so you can see what it controls when building your own settings UI.

takeaways.title: LumenCodeEditor no longer grows past its container
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `LumenCodeEditor` now takes its width from the column, drawer or form it sits in, so a long line scrolls inside the editor instead of pushing the panel past its edge.

takeaways.title: Drawer actions as data
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `LumenDrawer` now takes an `actions` prop (an array of the newly exported `DrawerAction` type), so you can add footer actions by passing `icon`, `label`, `onClick`, `busy`, `disabled`, `destructive`, `to` or `href` instead of drawing them yourself.

takeaways.title: Form field info as an InfoTip
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `LumenFormField` has a new `info` prop that shows help text in an `InfoTip` beside the label, and the old `hint` prop is deprecated and now draws the same way, so existing hints stop appearing as grey lines with no code change.

takeaways.title: Icon Cancel in forms
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, the Cancel button in `LumenForm` is now an × `IconButton` labelled "Cancel" instead of a text button, so every form picks up the compact look without changes.

takeaways.title: Check an app against the kit's patterns
takeaways.body: `lumen-ship check parts <folders>` now counts three pattern violations per folder (`hint-text`, `text-action`, `raw-overlay`) against a baseline file and fails if any count rises.

takeaways.title: A usage page for each part
takeaways.body: The docs now include one page each for the drawer, form, settings, status bar, picker and table, with the same headings on every page: Use it for, Anatomy, Do / Don't, Checked by.

takeaways.title: Agents read the rules before the props
takeaways.body: Each part page is served as markdown at `/parts/<name>.md`, listed in `llms.txt`, and placed first in `llms-full.txt`, so a coding agent that reads these files sees the usage rules before the prop reference.

takeaways.title: Start the check on an existing app
takeaways.body: Run `lumen-ship check parts <folders> --write-baseline` once to record the current counts, and after that the counts can only go down.

takeaways.title: Save is now an icon
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `SaveButton` renders as a filled `icon-sm` `IconButton`, and its `label` prop becomes the tooltip and `aria-label` instead of visible text.

takeaways.title: Icon fallback and busy spinner
takeaways.body: In `SaveButton`, `icon={null}` now falls back to a ✓, and the button shows a spinner while busy.

takeaways.title: Drawers skip empty footers
takeaways.body: `LumenDrawer` no longer renders a footer unless you pass `footer` or `footerStart`, and the text "Close" button is gone because the header × already closes the drawer on every layout.

takeaways.title: Compact issue chip
takeaways.body: The issue chip now shows `⚠ N`, with "N to fix" as its tooltip and `aria-label`, so you can show a validation count without any text in the layout.

takeaways.title: Text actions become icons
takeaways.body: Every `SaveButton`-based action loses its visible text, so tests that find it by text should query by accessible label, and any custom text buttons in your `LumenDrawer` `footer` should move to `IconButton`.

takeaways.title: Status bar driven by plain data
takeaways.body: In `LumenShell` from `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, the new `bar={{ sync, messages, work }}` prop lets an app describe its current state as data, and the kit draws the status bar in a fixed five-slot order (Sync, Work, Message, Page facts, End).

takeaways.title: Pages add their own status
takeaways.body: The new `useStatus({ sync, messages, facts })` hook lets a page contribute status while it is mounted. The newest sync wins, messages add up, and the first two facts show.

takeaways.title: Turn a query into a sync state
takeaways.body: `querySync(query, label?)` converts a data query into a sync state (Updated, Syncing, Saved copy, Offline or Did not update) that you can pass to `bar.sync` or `useStatus`.

takeaways.title: Status bar on phones
takeaways.body: On a phone, the bar shows only the most urgent item (error, then warning, then work, then sync), plus an ⓘ N chip that opens every item in a bottom sheet.

takeaways.title: Calmer bar
takeaways.body: The bar no longer scrolls sideways, and relative times refresh every 30 seconds only while the tab is visible.

takeaways.title: Name the assistant's table
takeaways.body: In @columenlabs/lumen-ai, `sqlAssistantStore(sql, { table })` now keeps the assistant's documents in a table you name, so a module can use its own table name; without the option it still uses `assistant_docs`.

takeaways.title: Move one person's rows at a time
takeaways.body: In lumen-person, `exportRows(sql, table, after, { where })` and `rowStats(sql, tables, where)` now take a `RowFilter` (`{ sql, args }`), so you can export and check only the rows that belong to one person when an old store keeps many people's rows in one table.

takeaways.title: Checked table names, bound filter values
takeaways.body: The new `table` option of `sqlAssistantStore` must be a plain identifier, and the values in a `RowFilter`'s `args` are bound as parameters, so only the filter's `sql` condition is code you write yourself.

takeaways.title: Read images with a prompt
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ai`, `Assistant.complete` now takes an optional `images` array of `CompleteImage` (`{ mediaType, data }`, with base64 `data`), so background work can read photos, screenshots or scanned pages through the assistant's own models.

takeaways.title: Images work with both sign-in routes
takeaways.body: The `images` option on `Assistant.complete` works with an API key or a plan sign-in, and Lumen formats the images for each provider: image blocks go before the text for one, and `input_image` parts follow an `input_text` part for the other.

takeaways.title: Existing calls are untouched
takeaways.body: Calls to `Assistant.complete` that omit `images` behave exactly as before, so this release needs no change in your app.

takeaways.title: One-shot assistant calls now work on a plan sign-in
takeaways.body: In @columenlabs/lumen-ai, `assistant.complete` and `compact` now send their prompt as a one-item user message list, so an app signed in with a subscription plan no longer gets a `400 Input must be a list` error. API-key sign-ins accept the same shape, so they need no change.

takeaways.title: `assistant.complete` now answers on a plan sign-in
takeaways.body: In @columenlabs/lumen-ai, `assistant.complete` now streams its call, so an app whose model access comes from a subscription plan sign-in gets an answer instead of a refusal.

takeaways.title: `/compact` works on a plan sign-in too
takeaways.body: The `/compact` command in @columenlabs/lumen-ai now streams its call the same way, so you can compact a conversation under a plan sign-in.

takeaways.title: Output cap is sent only with an API key
takeaways.body: `assistant.complete` and `/compact` now send the output token cap only when you authenticate with an API key, so the same code runs under both sign-in types without errors from the unsupported cap.

takeaways.title: App switcher tile keeps its full size in the brand row
takeaways.body: In `LumenAppSwitcher` from @columenlabs/lumen-ui, an app's own tile now draws at 32 px inside the sidebar menu button instead of shrinking to 16 px and turning into a circle, so you can drop any size overrides you added to work around it.

takeaways.title: One-shot answers for background work
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ai/assistant`, `Assistant.complete(caller, { task, system, prompt, maxTokens?, signal? })` runs a single answer on the tier you mapped to `task` in `createAssistant`'s `tasks` option, so jobs like scoring or summaries use the person's model, effort and payer instead of a separate model call.

takeaways.title: Background spend is counted like chat
takeaways.body: `Assistant.complete` follows `state.paying` to pick the payer (own key, or app key and allowance) and records spend through `addSpend`, so it appears in Settings spend and counts against the allowance and caps.

takeaways.title: Clear errors when nobody can pay
takeaways.body: `Assistant.complete` throws an `AssistantError` with code `not_connected`, `app_cap` or `own_cap` (402) when no payer is available, or `upstream` (502) when the model fails, so your job can wait on the first group and retry on the second.

takeaways.title: Full-size app tiles in the switcher
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, the new optional `tile` boolean on `LumenApp` (and on `SuiteApp`, passed through `suiteApps`) makes `LumenAppSwitcher` draw the app's `icon` or `iconUrl` at the full size of its box, so an app whose icon is already a coloured tile no longer shows a small glyph inside a second box.

takeaways.title: One store per person, shared by every app
takeaways.body: The new `@columenlabs/lumen-person` package exports `PersonObject`, a base class whose SQLite database holds the tables of every app for one person, so an app no longer needs its own per-person object.

takeaways.title: Call a person's store from the Worker
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-person`, `personCall` and `personModule` call a person's store from the Worker, and a call made from inside that person's store to the same person runs in place.

takeaways.title: A bad migration only breaks its own module
takeaways.body: In `PersonObject`, each module now migrates on its first call or wake, with each step in one transaction, so a step that throws makes only that module answer 503 (retried after a minute) while other modules keep working.

takeaways.title: One alarm shared by every module's wake
takeaways.body: In `PersonObject`, each module's wake time now goes through a single multiplexed alarm, and each wake gets a deadline you can set with the `wakeMs` option (default 30 s).

takeaways.title: No more made-up match counts on a search by meaning
takeaways.body: In @columenlabs/lumen-ai, a find that uses `like` no longer returns `count`, so an assistant stops quoting the pool of up to 50 nearest rows as a number of matches (for example "49 possible matches").

takeaways.title: A search by meaning now says it is approximate
takeaways.body: In @columenlabs/lumen-ai, a `like` find now returns `nearest: true` and a note telling the assistant to pick from the rows and not say how many match.

takeaways.title: `FindResult.count` is now optional
takeaways.body: In @columenlabs/lumen-ai, check that `count` is defined before you read it from a `FindResult`, because exact searches still return it and `like` searches leave it out.

takeaways.title: Find by meaning
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ai`, a find's `like` option (for example "something light for a hot day") now searches by meaning when you set `meaning: { fields, changed }` on the definition and call `findTool(def, sql, { meaning: vectorMeaning({ embed, index }) })`.

takeaways.title: Background indexing with `meaningStep`
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ai`, `meaningStep` is a budgeted background step you can run on a schedule to embed only rows whose `changed` column moved past a bookmark your app keeps, so the index stays current without re-embedding everything.

takeaways.title: Worked-out find fields
takeaways.body: On `FindField`, the new `sql` option lets a number, date or tag field be your app's own SQL over the row, such as `json_array_length(t.steps)` as a "quick" hint when no time is stored.

takeaways.title: Reliable counts
takeaways.body: Find results from `findTool` now carry `count`, `returned` and `same_name`, so a tool or model can report totals accurately and see when different rows share a name.

takeaways.title: One question becomes one query
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ai`, `findTool(def, sql)` gives an assistant a `<name>_find` tool, so it can answer a question about an app's records with a single filtered query instead of listing records and opening them one by one.

takeaways.title: Declare searchable fields once
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ai`, `defineFind` lets an app declare its table and its text, tag, number and date fields once, with JSON columns flattened for the index.

takeaways.title: Full-text index as a migration
takeaways.body: `findSql(def)` returns the additive full-text search table, its triggers and a `rebuild` fill, which you can run as a migration or a budgeted step.

takeaways.title: Ranked, filtered search in one bound query
takeaways.body: `runFind(def, sql, q)` runs one parameter-bound SELECT that combines tag filters, number and date ranges, ranked word matching, excluded words, a column filter, chosen fields, sort, a limit and the total match count.

takeaways.title: Read many records in one batch step
takeaways.body: In the `@columenlabs/lumen-ai` engine, the new built-in `batch` tool is offered whenever any read tool is enabled, takes `{calls: [{tool, input}]}` with 1 to 25 reads, runs them in parallel, and shows them as a single step.

takeaways.title: Plain checks no longer escalate
takeaways.body: The engine's escalation rule now treats checking many records against a plain rule (an ingredient, a date, a number, a name) as a lookup to do with `batch`, so the assistant answers it itself instead of handing it to a higher tier as "judgement".

takeaways.title: Batched reads keep dedupe, memory and step reporting
takeaways.body: Each call inside `batch` still goes through `runTool`, keeps the same-read-once dedupe and tool memory, and still fires `onStep`; results come back numbered, and drafts and writes are refused in a batch.

takeaways.title: Reuse what is already in the chat
takeaways.body: The engine's system rule now tells the assistant to read several records with one `batch` call and to reuse results already in the conversation, rather than re-reading them.

takeaways.title: Follow-up questions reuse earlier tool results
takeaways.body: In the `@columenlabs/lumen-ai` assistant, each answer's tool results are now stored on `Turn.ran` and replayed by `toolMemory` within one 40,000-character budget for the whole chat, so a follow-up like "List them all" no longer re-runs a list tool.

takeaways.title: The same read runs once per answer
takeaways.body: The `@columenlabs/lumen-ai` assistant no longer runs the same read tool with the same input twice within a single answer.

takeaways.title: `rowCount` counts the right rows
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ai`, `rowCount` no longer takes the first array in a result as the rows, so a list with `categories` first no longer reports "8 rows" every time and a single record no longer reports its ingredient count as rows.

takeaways.title: Assistant answers no longer open with its bearings
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ai`, the assistant no longer starts replies by echoing the "Bearings: date, time, timezone · …" context line, so answers from your assistant begin with the actual answer.

takeaways.title: Bearings are tagged for the model only
takeaways.body: In the `@columenlabs/lumen-ai` assistant, the bearings block is now wrapped in `<bearings> … </bearings>` and its header says it is for the model only and must never be repeated, so you can rely on the context staying out of user-facing text.

takeaways.title: Clearer rule about quoting bearings
takeaways.body: In the `@columenlabs/lumen-ai` assistant's `rules()`, the line that introduces bearings now tells the model never to quote them or start an answer with them, so you no longer need to add your own instruction to suppress the echo.

takeaways.title: Bound web link Test now shows its result
takeaways.body: In `Assistant.status()` from @columenlabs/lumen-ai, an app that reaches its web-fetch service over a service binding now gets the `test` field on the web link's status, so the Settings ▸ Assistant ▸ Web badge shows the last result instead of staying on "Not tested".

takeaways.title: Bound link tests are saved
takeaways.body: `POST /web/test` on a bound link now stores its result in its own app-scope doc, so a Test you run is still there after you reload Settings.

takeaways.title: Read the stored bound-link result from state
takeaways.body: The state object has a new reader for the bound link's saved doc, so custom code can read the last test without calling `Assistant.status()`.

takeaways.title: The assistant now knows the current time and when the chat last spoke
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ai/assistant`, `createAssistant` now puts a "Bearings" block (the server's current time in the user's zone and in UTC, plus how long ago the last message in the chat was) at the top of every user message, so the model no longer guesses the date.

takeaways.title: Add your own app lines to the bearings
takeaways.body: `createAssistant` accepts a new `app` name and a `bearings: (b, caller) => lines` option, and any lines your hook returns appear under the app name; a hook that takes longer than 300 ms or throws is skipped so a turn is never held up.

takeaways.title: Build bearings yourself
takeaways.body: `@columenlabs/lumen-ai/assistant` now exports `bearings()`, `bearingTime`, `bearingSpan` and `knownZone` for formatting the current time, elapsed spans and validating IANA zone names in your own code.

takeaways.title: The browser's time zone travels with each message
takeaways.body: `useAssistantChat` from `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` now sends the browser's IANA zone with every message, using the new optional `time_zone` field on `AssistantMessage` from `@columenlabs/lumen-ui-types/assistant`, which is backward compatible.

takeaways.title: The system prompt no longer carries a UTC date
takeaways.body: The assistant's system rule now tells the model to take today and now from the bearings, and because the bearings sit in the user message rather than the system prompt, the prompt cache still holds.

takeaways.title: Reach scrapeql web tools over a service binding
takeaways.body: In `createAssistant` from `@columenlabs/lumen-ai`, the `web.scrapeql` option now takes an optional `fetch` (the fetch of a service binding), so the assistant calls the `/mcp` endpoint through the binding and needs no service token.

takeaways.title: Assistant settings show a bound link
takeaways.body: In the `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` assistant settings, a bound `scrapeql` now appears as a `LumenConnection` with one read-only "App link" way and a Test button for admins, in place of the token form.

takeaways.title: Status says when the link is bound
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui-types`, `AssistantStatus.web.scrapeql` gains an optional `bound` boolean, so a client can tell a binding from a stored token.

takeaways.title: Long Settings section lists now scroll
takeaways.body: In `LumenSettings` from `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, the desktop dialog's left section list scrolls on its own when an app has more sections than fit the dialog height, so every section can be reached.

takeaways.title: Search stays pinned above the list
takeaways.body: In `LumenSettings`, the nav search no longer scrolls away, because only the groups live in the new scroll area (`data-slot="settings-nav-list"`) that you can target for styling.

takeaways.title: Deep-linked sections scroll into view
takeaways.body: When `LumenSettings` opens on a section far down the list, for example through the assistant's `settings` move or a `?settings=<id>` link, that row is now scrolled into view.

takeaways.title: `savedAnswers` no longer crashes on import when the browser blocks storage
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `savedAnswers` now reads `indexedDB` inside a try, so a browser that throws a `SecurityError` on `window.indexedDB` no longer stops your app from drawing.

takeaways.title: Missing storage falls back to the server
takeaways.body: When `indexedDB` is unavailable, `savedAnswers` switches to its no-op persister, so every load asks the server and your app still gets its data.

takeaways.title: A throwing `open` is retried later
takeaways.body: If `indexedDB.open` throws synchronously, `savedAnswers` now rejects the promise instead of throwing, so the store is tried again on a later call.

takeaways.title: `StatusMessages` no longer takes `max`
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, delete the `max` prop from every `<StatusMessages>` you render, because the component now always shows a single line and TypeScript will flag any call that still passes it.

takeaways.title: The status bar shows only the latest message
takeaways.body: `StatusMessages` in `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` renders the first entry of `messages` (newest first). A new message replaces the one on screen, so two different errors no longer appear as two chips side by side.

takeaways.title: Earlier messages sit behind the `+N` chip
takeaways.body: In `StatusMessages`, every message except the newest is listed behind the `+N` chip in the order it was posted. Errors are no longer sorted ahead of other messages, so the newest message always wins.

takeaways.title: A wider status line
takeaways.body: The `--status-message-max` CSS variable is now `min(40rem, 45vw)` from 768px and `55vw` below that, so the single line has more room. Override the variable if your layout needs a different width.

takeaways.title: Whole-number axes on stacked columns
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `StackedColumns` now labels its value axis in whole steps of 1, 2 or 5 × 10ⁿ (never below 1) when every plotted value is a whole number, so a day with 2 API calls reads 0, 1, 2 instead of 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2.

takeaways.title: Whole-number axes on the line chart
takeaways.body: The line chart in `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` now uses the same `niceTicks` rule, so count data such as small usage totals no longer shows fractional ticks, while charts with fractional values are unchanged.

takeaways.title: One `main` landmark per page
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `PageBody` now renders a `div` instead of a `<main>`, so pages inside the shell no longer nest `<main>` in the shell's `SidebarInset` (which is already the page's `<main>`) and screen readers hear a single main landmark.

takeaways.title: `fetchWithin` puts a deadline on any request
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, call `fetchWithin(url, init, ms)` to make a raw `fetch` reject with a `TimeoutError` after `ms` milliseconds. A `signal` you pass in `init` still aborts it, and the new `FETCH_MS` constant (15 s) is the default to pass.

takeaways.title: Built-in requests no longer wait forever
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, the app switcher, What's new, notifications (reads and writes), tasks and market data now give up after `FETCH_MS`. The new-build check gives up after 5 s. A stalled network can no longer leave these hanging. The assistant's chat stream deliberately keeps the caller's `signal`, since a stream can legitimately run for a long time.

takeaways.title: Prod safety rules are now concrete
takeaways.body: The repo's contributor guide now says where timeouts belong (`savedAnswers`, `API_TIMEOUT_MS`, `fetchWithin`, and `AbortSignal.timeout` in worker code). It also says that fixing up old data on read should go through `waitUntil`, and that a changed JSON shape gets a new key version. The review checklist now blocks any pull request that breaks one of these rules.

takeaways.title: Clearer Admins tile caption
takeaways.body: In `LumenPeople` from `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, the Admins tile caption now reads "Can’t remove the last admin" instead of "at least 1 always kept", so your users see the rule in plain words with no prop or config change.

takeaways.title: Requests no longer hang forever
takeaways.body: `apiJson` from @columenlabs/lumen-ui now gives up after 15 s for reads and 60 s for writes, so a request the network never answers no longer leaves a page loading indefinitely.

takeaways.title: Set a timeout per call
takeaways.body: pass `timeoutMs` in the `init` argument of `apiJson` to override the limit for one request, or import the exported `API_TIMEOUT_MS` constant to see the defaults.

takeaways.title: Timeouts land in your existing error states
takeaways.body: when `apiJson` times out it throws an `ApiError` with status 0 ("The server didn't answer in time …"), which is reported and counted like a network failure, so the error and empty states you already handle take over without code changes.

takeaways.title: Prod safety rules for everyone working on Lumen
takeaways.body: This release changes no package code, so there is nothing to upgrade or migrate in `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `-ui-types`, `-ship`, `-auth`, `-ops` or `-ai`. The repo's agent guidelines now have a dedicated production safety section, which contributors and coding agents follow when changing the kit.

takeaways.title: The open row no longer shows a doubled focus marker
takeaways.body: In the Lumen theme stylesheet shipped with `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, a table row marked `aria-selected="true"` now sets `outline: none` on `:focus-visible`, so stepping through rows with ↑ / ↓ shows only the row's fill and left bar. A focused row that is not open keeps its normal focus ring.

takeaways.title: Stacked bars trend style
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` trend charts, set the trend style to the new `stacked_bars` value (now listed in `chartTrendStyles` and `WIDGET_STYLES`) to draw one bar per bucket with the series stacked, a 2px card-colour gap between parts, and a rounded end on the top part.

takeaways.title: Legend toggles each series
takeaways.body: In a multi-series trend, `ChartLegendContent` now renders toggle buttons (new `off` and `onSeries` props, with `aria-pressed`), so users can tap a legend item to hide or show that series. The last visible series can't be hidden.

takeaways.title: Total for stacked charts
takeaways.body: Charts using `stacked_bars` or `stacked` now read the total of the series currently shown, with the headline reading `Total · <bucket>` and the tooltip ending in a Total line.

takeaways.title: Top gridline no longer overstates bars
takeaways.body: Every trend chart in `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` now leaves 8px above the top gridline, so a bar of 17.3K no longer looks like it reaches an `18K` label.

takeaways.title: Mark the open row beside a docked drawer
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `LumenView`, `LumenTable`, `LumenViewCard` and `LumenLayout` accept a new optional `openKey` prop (`string | null`), so an app with its own drawer opened through `onOpen` can pass the key of the open row and have it highlighted.

takeaways.title: Open row is exposed to assistive tech
takeaways.body: With `openKey` set, the matching row gets `aria-selected="true"` and the other rows get `false`, plus an accent fill and a 3px accent bar on its leading edge.

takeaways.title: Arrow keys move the docked drawer
takeaways.body: In `LumenTable` and `LumenView`, pressing ↑ or ↓ on a focused row steps to the next data row, and while a row is open the step opens that row too, so the drawer follows the keyboard.

takeaways.title: Open row scrolls into view
takeaways.body: When the row named by `openKey` appears, whether opened by keyboard or on a page that holds it, it scrolls into view clear of the pinned header.

takeaways.title: Seal each person's data with the envelope codec
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-vault/envelope` (a new package), a master key can now seal values per person, with your app supplying a `WrappedKeyStore` and naming the AAD for each value.

takeaways.title: Per-region keys with the regional codec
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-vault/regional`, `MasterKeys` caches one raw master key per region, and `dataKey` creates a person's data key on first use (the first stored key wins).

takeaways.title: Fails closed, and unlock events never carry secrets
takeaways.body: In the envelope codec, a missing master key now refuses to seal or open unless you pass `allowPlain` to opt into the readable `plain.` mode, and the `onUnlock` hook only receives `{owner, event, ms, error?}`, never a key or a value.

takeaways.title: Tabs fold into a More menu
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `LumenTabs` now keeps the tabs that fit and folds the rest into a **More ▾** menu at the end of the row, so you no longer get a tab cut in half, and no code changes are needed.

takeaways.title: The More button shows the open tab
takeaways.body: When the open tab sits inside the More menu of `LumenTabs`, the button shows that tab's icon, name and count and is underlined like any open tab, so users can always see where they are.

takeaways.title: No false fade on tiny overflow
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `useScrollFade` no longer counts an overflow of 2 px or less as "more beyond", so a page with a rounding overflow no longer fades its right edge.

takeaways.title: savedAnswers persister for react-query
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, pass `savedAnswers({ name, restoreMs?, writeMs? })` as the persister of `PersistQueryClientProvider` to keep query answers in IndexedDB.

takeaways.title: A slow restore no longer leaves an app blank
takeaways.body: In `savedAnswers`, a restore that hasn't answered within the `restoreMs` option (default 1.5 s) now resolves empty, so the app asks the server instead of waiting on a hung read.

takeaways.title: Aborted or blocked storage rejects instead of hanging
takeaways.body: `savedAnswers` now rejects when an IndexedDB transaction aborts or the open is blocked, and it retries a failed open on the next call.

takeaways.title: Writes are batched
takeaways.body: Using the `writeMs` option (default one second), `savedAnswers` collects writes into a single stored record instead of writing on every change.

takeaways.title: A filter that matches nothing no longer hides the filter
takeaways.body: In `LumenView` from @columenlabs/lumen-ui, while a filter is on (`filterCount > 0`) your `state` now shows in the table body under the headers, so the filter box, chips and tools stay visible and the filter can be seen and cleared (with no filter, `state` still replaces the table as before).

takeaways.title: Clear filters button on empty tables
takeaways.body: `LumenView` and `LumenTable` have a new `onClearFilter` prop that shows a **Clear filters** button when a filtered table is empty, including under the kit's own "No rows match.", and `LumenLayout` and `LumenViewCard` already wire it to the new `useLumenFilter().clear`.

takeaways.title: No filter counts over a single server page
takeaways.body: `useLumenFilter({ partial })` hides the counts in the filter menu (Text contains, values, fields, number condition) when your rows are only one page of a server's set, and `LumenLayout` sets it from `paging` when there are more pages, the page is above 0, or the total is larger than the rows.

takeaways.title: Say what an empty table body says
takeaways.body: `LumenTable` has a new `emptyState` prop for the text or content shown in the body when no rows are left.

takeaways.title: Narrow tables drop columns instead of scrolling
takeaways.body: In `LumenView` from @columenlabs/lumen-ui, a table that is too narrow for its columns, for example beside a docked `LumenDrawer`, now hides columns until it fits, so the page no longer scrolls sideways and the first column is no longer cut off.

takeaways.title: Choose which columns go first
takeaways.body: On `ViewField` from @columenlabs/lumen-ui-types, the new `priority` number (default 0) lets you mark columns as more or less important, and the lowest-priority columns are dropped first.

takeaways.title: Key columns always stay
takeaways.body: In `LumenView` tables, the name column and the currently sorted column are never dropped, and columns that set `hideOnPhone` count as one priority lower, so they go before other columns of the same priority.

takeaways.title: Stacked chart value-axis labels stay on one line
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `StackedColumns` now draws every value-axis tick as a single line, so a label like `300 GB` no longer splits at the space or runs off the top of the chart.

takeaways.title: Column/line chart axes no longer wrap
takeaways.body: The column/line chart in `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` now uses the same single-line tick on both of its value axes, so your labels with units stay readable at desktop and phone widths.

takeaways.title: Axis gutters leave more room per character
takeaways.body: The chart axis width calculation in `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` now allows 7.5px per character (was 7), so your axes reserve slightly more space for longer labels without any change to props.

takeaways.title: Optional page footer under tables
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui-types`, `viewPaginationSchema` has a new `footer` field (default `false`), and setting `pagination.footer` to `true` on a view shows a footer pager under the table, for local paging, `ServerPaging` and server group pages.

takeaways.title: `LumenPageFooter` component
takeaways.body: `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` now exports `LumenPageFooter`, which shows the row range, first/previous/next/last buttons, numbered pages and a Go to box, so you can use it directly when building your own paged layouts.

takeaways.title: `pageList` helper
takeaways.body: `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` now exports `pageList(page, pages, more)`, which returns the numbered pages to show (first, last, current ±1) with `null` for each gap, so you can render your own page links.

takeaways.title: `foot` slot on `LumenWidget`
takeaways.body: `LumenWidget` accepts a new `foot` slot that renders under the body and above the load line, so you can add footer content to any widget.

takeaways.title: Docked side panel for row details
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `LumenDrawer` now takes `dock="<name>"`, so inside `LumenShell` the drawer sits beside the page instead of over it, a click on the page leaves it open, and clicking the next row swaps its content.

takeaways.title: Resize, fold and remember the dock
takeaways.body: A docked `LumenDrawer` can be dragged by its left edge (or with arrow keys on the focused edge, or double-clicked to reset) between `minSize` and `maxSize`, folded to a titled rail with the Collapse and Expand buttons, and its width and fold state are saved per dock name.

takeaways.title: Esc behaves predictably in a docked drawer
takeaways.body: Pressing Esc inside a docked `LumenDrawer` closes it, unless a picker inside it is open, and Esc from a dialog opened by the drawer closes only that dialog.

takeaways.title: Default footer Close is a plain button
takeaways.body: The default footer Close in `LumenDrawer` is now an ordinary button that calls your `onClose`, so it behaves the same whether the drawer is docked or an overlay.

takeaways.title: Phone table rows never wrap
takeaways.body: In the `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` theme, every card row of a `table[data-cards]` table on a phone is now a single non-wrapping line, with the select box, the name (`data-card="lead"`, truncated) and one value (`data-card="meta"`) on the right, so your tables no longer show two-line rows.

takeaways.title: LumenView picks the one phone value for you
takeaways.body: In `LumenView`, the value shown on a phone row is now the sorted column, else the first number or date column, else the next column, so changing the sort changes which value the row shows.

takeaways.title: `hideOnPhone` columns are skipped when choosing the phone value
takeaways.body: In `LumenView`, a column marked `hideOnPhone` is never picked for the row's one value, so a table whose second column is hidden on phone still shows a value on the right.

takeaways.title: A two-line row now fails the interaction smoke
takeaways.body: The interaction smoke check at 390×844 now fails on any `tbody tr` that wraps onto two lines, so you can catch a wrapping row in your own app before it ships.

takeaways.title: Keep the status bar tidy with `StatusMessages`
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, pass `StatusMessages` a `messages` array of `{ text, tone?, count? }` and an optional `max` (default 2), and it shows one line per message, errors first, with extra messages behind a `+N` chip and repeats merged into `×N`.

takeaways.title: Read full status messages on touch and keyboard
takeaways.body: In `StatusMessages`, a long message is cut off with an ellipsis and its full text opens in a pop-up on mouse hover, on a finger tap or from the keyboard, so phone users can read it too.

takeaways.title: Status pop-ups no longer close each other
takeaways.body: In `StatusHealth`, moving the mouse from one open status pop-up to another used to close the new one because focus went back to the old trigger, and now the new pop-up stays open.

takeaways.title: Esc closes only the topmost popup
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `DialogContent`, `SheetContent` and `AlertDialogContent` now use `escapeToPicker` as their `onEscapeKeyDown`, so pressing Esc while a `LumenSelector` or `Combobox` popup is open closes only that popup and not the dialog around it.

takeaways.title: Sort by on phones
takeaways.body: `LumenView` now shows a `Sort by` picker and a High to low / Low to high toggle above its card rows on small screens, so users can sort a table on a phone, where the header row is hidden.

takeaways.title: Readable tag chips
takeaways.body: `ColorChip` text is now its colour mixed 55% with `--foreground`, so any chip hue reaches 4.5:1 contrast in light and dark themes, and the tint and dot stay the same.

takeaways.title: Higher-contrast tinted badges
takeaways.body: The `success`, `warning`, `info` and `destructive` badge variants now lean their text 20% toward the foreground, up from about 4.2:1, so no change is needed in your app.

takeaways.title: Cards scroll with their page outside the grid
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `LumenWidget` (and `LumenViewCard`, which builds on it) is now as tall as its content, so a card in a scrolling column such as a Settings panel or a drawer no longer clips its rows and the column scrolls to the end.

takeaways.title: Grid cells still fill their height
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, a `LumenWidget` placed in a `LumenGrid` cell is stretched to the cell's full height, so dashboards laid out in the grid look the same as before.

takeaways.title: Folded state is exposed as `data-folded`
takeaways.body: A folded `LumenWidget` now renders a `data-folded` attribute, which you can target in CSS (for example `[data-folded]`) to style or size folded cards differently.

takeaways.title: Plan-sign-in requests no longer send an output cap
takeaways.body: In the `@columenlabs/lumen-ai` assistant engine, requests made through a provider's plan sign-in route now omit `max_output_tokens`, so answers that used to end empty come back normally. The API-key path still sends the tier's cap.

takeaways.title: Tool schemas drop the `$schema` line
takeaways.body: The assistant engine in `@columenlabs/lumen-ai` now strips the generated `$schema` line (via `withoutMeta`) from every tool schema it sends, for every provider.

takeaways.title: The low-effort retry only runs when the model wrote tokens
takeaways.body: In the `@columenlabs/lumen-ai` assistant engine, a stop with 0 output tokens is no longer asked again, which avoids a pointless second call.

takeaways.title: Clearer message when the model stops before reading
takeaways.body: The assistant engine in `@columenlabs/lumen-ai` now tells users the provider stopped before reading the message and suggests trying again or picking another model for the tier. The "spent the whole answer thinking" message now appears only for answers that were all thinking.

takeaways.title: Group and fold rows stay on one line on a phone
takeaways.body: In `LumenView`'s phone card layout (`table[data-cards]`), group headers and sub-group folds now carry `data-rollup` and render as a single non-wrapping line, so the roll-up figure (such as share %) stays on the right instead of dropping to a second line.

takeaways.title: The Total row label shows on a phone
takeaways.body: In `LumenView`, the Total row's name cell is now marked `data-card="lead"`, so the "Total" label is no longer hidden in the card layout.

takeaways.title: Long group names truncate instead of wrapping
takeaways.body: In `LumenView`, group and fold names now truncate with the full name on hover, counts never shrink, and group names cap at the `--lead-col-max` CSS variable. Content you pass through `mark`, `rollRender` or `groupActions` can no longer wrap the row.

takeaways.title: Coverage map opens on whole blocks on phones
takeaways.body: In `LumenCoverageMap` from @columenlabs/lumen-ui, the year strip still opens at today on a small screen, but `snapToEnd` now leaves just enough room at its end for the left edge to land on a whole block, so labels like "13" are no longer cut to "3".

takeaways.title: Readable chip text on any background
takeaways.body: From @columenlabs/lumen-ui, the new `readableInk(bg, ink?, min = 4.5)` returns your own text colour when it reads at the `min` contrast ratio on `bg`, and otherwise returns near-black or white, whichever reads better.

takeaways.title: Measure contrast between two colours
takeaways.body: From @columenlabs/lumen-ui, the new `contrast(a, b)` returns the contrast ratio of two colours, so you can check or test text legibility yourself.

takeaways.title: Phone cards can name their counts
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui-types`, the new optional `ViewField.cardUnit` is shown after the number on a phone card when no header names a bare count (`5,861 msgs`).

takeaways.title: Scrolling rows fade at their edges
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, the new `useScrollFade` hook sets `data-fade` (`start`, `end` or `both`) on a sideways-scrolling row, and the theme fades that edge. `LumenTabs` and the `LumenCoverageMap` strip already use it.

takeaways.title: Status items keep their label on a phone
takeaways.body: `StatusItem` in `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` no longer drops its label on a narrow screen, so a status bar reads `Label · Up to date` instead of a bare value.

takeaways.title: Units sit next to their numbers on cards
takeaways.body: `UnitValue` inside a phone card now puts the unit right after the number (`2.2 GB`) instead of in the column's narrow unit slot, which left a wide gap.

takeaways.title: Coverage map rows are readable on a phone
takeaways.body: On a phone, `LumenCoverageMap` puts each row's name on its own line above its blocks, so blocks never draw under the name.

takeaways.title: DetailsTable's growing column no longer collapses
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, a `DetailsTable` column marked `grow` now keeps a minimum width of `min(10rem, 40vw)`, so names stay readable in a half-width card, and long names still end in an ellipsis.

takeaways.title: Long names in DetailsTable now truncate
takeaways.body: In `DetailsTable` from `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, a column marked `grow` (usually the name) now ends a long value such as `<account-id>_market-data` in an ellipsis instead of stretching the row.

takeaways.title: `grow` takes only the spare width
takeaways.body: A `grow` column in `DetailsTable` now fills the leftover space and no more, and its content is capped at the cell width, so you can mark your name column `grow` without extra CSS.

takeaways.title: Other columns stay inside the card
takeaways.body: The columns next to a `grow` column in `DetailsTable` are no longer pushed out of the card on desktop, and the table no longer scrolls sideways on phones.

takeaways.title: Text values on `Tile` keep the text font
takeaways.body: In `Tile` from `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, a string `value` with no digit, such as "Workers Paid" or "Healthy", now renders in the text font, while numeric values stay in the mono `.num` style.

takeaways.title: `Tile` captions read as text
takeaways.body: In `Tile` from `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, the `caption` now uses the text font with `tabular-nums` instead of `.num`, so phrases like "Paid, beyond included" or "8 at 90% or more" look like sentences and digits still line up.

takeaways.title: Phone `Sidebar` shows its close button
takeaways.body: In `Sidebar` from `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, the phone drawer now shows the sheet's close × and pads the header on the right, so users can always dismiss it and the brand never runs under the button.

takeaways.title: Phone tables as cards
takeaways.body: In `LumenView` from @columenlabs/lumen-ui, tables below 640px now show each row as a card, and you can style the parts through the new `data-card` attribute on each cell (`lead`, `meta`, `num`, `text`, `select`).

takeaways.title: Phone tables no longer run off the edge
takeaways.body: `LumenView` tables now fit the view on a phone instead of widening their card, so numbers, dates and units keep their full width while only text shortens with an ellipsis.

takeaways.title: Custom closed-field text for selectors
takeaways.body: `LumenSelector` has a new `display` prop, so you can set what the closed field shows instead of the picked option's label.

takeaways.title: Plainer status bar
takeaways.body: `StatusItem` now separates label and value with a "·" (for example "Mail · Up to date") and shows the value in the text font with tabular figures, and `StatusTimeZone` shows the zone's short name such as "PT".

takeaways.title: Compact What's new trigger
takeaways.body: `WhatsNew` now shows a sparkle and "What's new" (icon only on a phone), and the version and build name appear only in the drawer.

takeaways.title: Smaller first load for every page
takeaways.body: In an app's production build, the entry file from `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` drops from 343 KB to 310 KB gzipped, so pages using Lumen components load less code up front.

takeaways.title: `LumenDrawer` fetches its resizable panels late
takeaways.body: On desktop, the drawer's resizable panels are now a lazy part fetched 2 seconds after a `LumenDrawer` mounts, so the first open already has them, and phones never download them.

takeaways.title: `LumenWidget` no longer pulls in the Edit-widget settings
takeaways.body: Pages that only draw a widget with `LumenWidget` stop downloading the settings editor and its drag-and-drop library.

takeaways.title: `SummaryCardsEditor` split from the read-only cards
takeaways.body: `LumenCard`, `SummaryTiles`, `cardAgg` and `summaryCardIssues` no longer share a module with the drag-to-reorder editor, so the drag library only loads where the editor is used.

takeaways.title: Sizes in their own unit
takeaways.body: In `ViewFormat`, the new `format: 'bytes'` shows each value in its own decimal unit (`2.2 GB`, `84.1 MB`, `120 KB`), so you no longer divide by a fixed unit and label the column `Size (MB)`.

takeaways.title: Byte helpers for custom code
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ui-types/views`, `bytesParts(b)` returns `['45.2', 'MB']` and `formatBytes(b)` returns the full string, so your own cells and labels match the built-in format.

takeaways.title: Short zone names
takeaways.body: `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` now exports `zoneAbbr(tz)` from prefs, which returns a short generic zone name such as `PT`, `ET` or `UTC` (never `PDT`, `PST` or `GMT+0`).

takeaways.title: Times in the person's zone, with its name
takeaways.body: The People pages' `when()` (Last seen, Sent, Saved by) and the Audit log's Day and When columns now use `getPrefs().timeZone` and name the zone, so `today 02:18 AM` becomes `today 7:18 PM PT`.

takeaways.title: Schedules read in the viewer's zone
takeaways.body: The Schedules When column now converts clock times from the schedule's own `tz` into the viewer's zone, so `Daily at 3:15 AM UTC` reads `Daily at 8:15 PM PT`.

takeaways.title: Plan sign-in answers are no longer empty
takeaways.body: In the `@columenlabs/lumen-ai` assistant engine, requests made through a plan sign-in now send `max_output_tokens`, taken from the tier's `out` value (16K by default), so the model can no longer spend its whole output on reasoning and return only "…(cut)".

takeaways.title: One automatic retry for all-thinking answers
takeaways.body: If a plan answer still comes back incomplete with reason `max_output_tokens` and no words or tool calls, the assistant engine now asks once more with `reasoning.effort` set to `low`, so your users get text instead of a cut mark.

takeaways.title: Silent turns stay out of chat history
takeaways.body: Earlier assistant turns that said nothing (only "…(cut)") are now dropped from the history the engine sends upstream, so stored plan chats stop inheriting the empty answers.

takeaways.title: Clearer message when nothing works
takeaways.body: If the retry also fails, the assistant now shows a message explaining that the model spent the whole answer thinking and wrote nothing, instead of a bare reason code.

takeaways.title: Tile rows no longer leave a gap under cards
takeaways.body: In `LumenGrid` from @columenlabs/lumen-ui, a card's floating corner actions no longer count toward its measured height, so tile rows sit 12px apart instead of 40px.

takeaways.title: Dark-mode chart grids stay subtle
takeaways.body: `LumenEChart` now applies your `axisStyle` under every `xAxis` and `yAxis` your option sets (your own keys still win), so a chart that names no axis colours no longer draws a bright white grid in dark mode.

takeaways.title: Phone tile grids fill every row
takeaways.body: On a phone, `SummaryTiles` now makes an odd last tile span the full row, and `TileToggleGroup` shows two tiles per row instead of three with an empty grey cell.

takeaways.title: Phone status bar keeps its far end visible
takeaways.body: In `StatusItem`, on a phone a label with a value now drops and a lone label truncates, so items at the end of the bar (such as a version or time zone) stay on screen.

takeaways.title: `DetailsTable` text matches `LumenView`
takeaways.body: Only right-aligned (number) columns now take the `.num` font, so name and badge columns keep the regular text font inside drawers.

takeaways.title: Query cache that survives reloads
takeaways.body: `createDeskQueryClient` in @columenlabs/lumen-ui takes a new `persist: { key, buster?, maxAge? }` option that saves successful reads to `localStorage` and shows them on the first render after a reload or an app switch, then refetches anything past `staleTime` in the background.

takeaways.title: Tasks tray reads once per load
takeaways.body: In @columenlabs/lumen-ui, `TasksProvider` now has a stable `refresh`, so the tray makes one task-list request per page load instead of 5 to 7, and polling slows from 3 s to 15 s once a task has run for a minute.

takeaways.title: Smaller first load for icons, emoji and CSV
takeaways.body: In @columenlabs/lumen-ui, `iconOf` and `lucideIcon`, the `IconPicker` name list and Emoji tab, and the `LumenView` Download CSV button now load their code on first use, which cut one dashboard app's entry bundle from 1,442 KB to 1,118 KB raw (423 KB to 343 KB gzipped).

takeaways.title: Clear messages for stream errors
takeaways.body: In @columenlabs/lumen-ai, an error event inside an assistant answer's stream is now logged as `assistant_openai_error` and shown to the person as a plain sentence chosen by its error code, instead of the generic "refused the request (error)".

takeaways.title: Name a fold line under its group
takeaways.body: In `LumenView`, a `ViewSubgroup` now takes an optional `title` function, `(key, rows, groupBy) => string`, so a folded or flat line can show a short name (for example "Reads" instead of "Product · Reads") while the full key stays in the hover title.

takeaways.title: Row bands reach the table's right edge
takeaways.body: In the `LumenView` table, group, fold, part, data and Total rows now draw the `+` (add column) cell and full-width rows span it, so group tints and row hover no longer stop one column short and leave a white gap.

takeaways.title: Answers no longer come back empty when the final event has no output
takeaways.body: the assistant engine in `@columenlabs/lumen-ai` now reads output items from the streamed item-done events, and falls back to the streamed text, so a plan that used to answer with 0 tokens and a bare `…(cut)` now returns its answer.

takeaways.title: An answer with no words says why
takeaways.body: when the assistant engine in `@columenlabs/lumen-ai` gets no words and no tool calls, it now shows "stopped before answering" with the reason, or "sent no answer", instead of a bare `…(cut)`.

takeaways.title: Empty and failed answers are logged with their shape
takeaways.body: the assistant engine in `@columenlabs/lumen-ai` now logs a dedicated event for each case, so you can find the cause in your logs without any message content being recorded.

takeaways.title: LumenWidget loads its chart code only when it draws one
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `LumenWidget`'s allocation widget (bar list, donut and allocation bar) now loads as a lazy part, so an app's first file no longer includes the charts library on pages without an allocation chart. Props and markup are unchanged.

takeaways.title: LumenCard's progress ring loads on demand
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `LumenCard` with style `progress_circle` now loads the ring lazily behind a round skeleton of the same size, so cards in other styles no longer pull in the charts library.

takeaways.title: OverviewPage defers its chart widgets
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `OverviewPage`'s ring, bars and timeline widgets now load lazily, so the charts library becomes a separate chunk instead of part of every app's first file.

takeaways.title: Check for a Settings section from the shell
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `useShell()` now returns `hasSettings(id)`, so you can check whether the shell's own Settings section list includes a section such as `hasSettings('notifications')` before linking to it.

takeaways.title: Tasks tray no longer links to a missing Notifications section
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, the `TaskPanel` footer ("Phone or email when a task ends: Settings ▸ Notifications") now appears only when `hasSettings('notifications')` is true, so apps without that section no longer show a dead link.

takeaways.title: Doc reads in one request are batched into a single store call
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ai`, `Docs.cached()` now gathers the reads asked in the same tick and sends them as one `getMany`, so a request that reads several docs makes far fewer store round trips.

takeaways.title: Stores can now implement an optional `getMany`
takeaways.body: Add `AssistantStore.getMany?(refs)` to your own store to return several docs in one call, in the order asked; `sqlAssistantStore` already implements it with a single `SELECT`.

takeaways.title: The assistant `/status` reads run in parallel
takeaways.body: The assistant `/status` handler in `@columenlabs/lumen-ai` now fans its reads out with `Promise.all`, so its many store calls drop to a few, one per await step.

takeaways.title: One card for every key, sign-in and connector
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `LumenConnection` renders a collapsed row (logo, name, meta line, one status pill) that opens to show how the connection is set up.

takeaways.title: Several ways to connect, with one in use
takeaways.body: In `LumenConnection`, each way is either pasted `fields` (prefix checks are reported through `SaveButton` issues), a `signin` (opens a tab, then you paste back the address it ended on) or your own `form`. With two or more ways, each gets a radio and the active one is tagged **In use**.

takeaways.title: Test, remove and replace built in
takeaways.body: Each way that is set up in `LumenConnection` shows who or what it is (`ident`), when it last worked, and the actions Test, Remove (confirmed with `LumenConfirm`) and Replace or Sign in again.

takeaways.title: Icons on expandable rows
takeaways.body: `LumenExpandRow` now takes an `icon` prop, so the row can show a logo or glyph next to its title.

takeaways.title: Status helpers
takeaways.body: `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` also exports `ConnectionLogo`, `ConnectionBadge`, `connectionStatus` and `activeWay`, so you can reuse the logo, the status pill and the status logic outside the card.

takeaways.title: Background jobs on the server
takeaways.body: The new `@columenlabs/lumen-tasks` package has `createTasks({ db, onEnd?, keepDays? })`, which keeps a job ledger in any SQLite database (use the `doSql` or `d1Sql` adapter for `db`), so any app can run async jobs.

takeaways.title: Ready-made task routes
takeaways.body: `taskRoutes({ base, tasks, owner })` from `@columenlabs/lumen-tasks` returns a plain fetch handler that serves the routes `TasksProvider` already calls, and it only accepts same-origin JSON writes.

takeaways.title: Stuck jobs clean themselves up
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-tasks`, every read runs the reaper, which fails a task left open past `limitMinutes` (default 15), so `progress` answers `stop: true` to a cancelled or reaped job and no cron is needed.

takeaways.title: Buttons that show their own job
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `useTaskFor(kind, ref)` lets a button show that its own job is running, and `useTasks().track(task)` shows a just-started task at once.

takeaways.title: Tasks carry the engine's id
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui-types`, `Task` has a new optional `ref` field for the engine's own id for the work, which `useTaskFor` matches on.

takeaways.title: A shared bar for ticked rows
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, the new `LumenBulkBar` takes `count`, `label`, `onClear` and your actions as children, so an app can show how many rows are ticked, offer bulk actions and clear the selection without building its own bar.

takeaways.title: The bar hides itself at zero
takeaways.body: `LumenBulkBar` renders nothing when `count` is 0, so you can pair it with LumenLayout's `selection` and it appears only while rows are ticked.

takeaways.title: LumenPeople uses the shared bar
takeaways.body: The bulk bar in `LumenPeople` now renders through `LumenBulkBar` with unchanged behaviour, so existing apps need no changes.

takeaways.title: A table's name column no longer fills a phone screen
takeaways.body: In the `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` table, the lead column's `--lead-col-max` CSS variable now defaults to `min(18rem, 55vw)`, so the next column stays visible on a 390 px phone without sideways scrolling, and desktop width is unchanged.

takeaways.title: Leaner first load for lumen-ui apps
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, the Edit widget dialog in `LumenView` and `LumenLayout`, the charts in `LumenWidget` and in `LumenChart`'s dialog, `WhatsNew` in the shell, and the assistant panel's markdown rendering now load when they first appear. One hub app's entry chunk dropped from 2.59 MB to 1.14 MB raw (764 KB to 342 KB gzip), with no import changes.

takeaways.title: One read per stored doc per request
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ai`, `Docs.cached()` returns a docs handle that reads each stored document at most once per request, so repeated lookups in one request stop hitting the store.

takeaways.title: Assistant on cached docs
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ai`, `Assistant.forRequest()` gives you an assistant view over the request's cached docs, so it shares those single reads instead of fetching again.

takeaways.title: Forms inside a fieldset now fit their drawer
takeaways.body: A `<fieldset>` wrapped around a form, for example to disable it for read-only viewers, no longer grows wider than its `LumenDrawer` from `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` or a dialog, because the Lumen theme's base styles now set `fieldset { min-inline-size: 0 }`, so inputs are no longer cut off on the right.

takeaways.title: FactList for label/value rows
takeaways.body: `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` now exports `FactList`, which renders label/value rows where each label stays on one line and each value truncates with its full text in the `title` attribute.

takeaways.title: Drawers and expand rows truncate instead of wrapping
takeaways.body: In `LumenDrawer`, the title and description now stay on one line with an ellipsis and show the full text on hover, and `LumenExpandRow` does the same for its name and meta.

takeaways.title: Times and short values never wrap
takeaways.body: The `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` theme styles now keep `span.num` (except `line-clamp-*`), `dd.num`, `<time>` and `<kbd>` on one line, so times and ids no longer break across lines.

takeaways.title: Relative times no longer split
takeaways.body: The People `when()` and `fromNow()` helpers now use non-breaking spaces, so `07:18 PM` and `in 7 d` stay together in any text you put them in.

takeaways.title: Failed email sends show the server's own reason
takeaways.body: In `LumenEmailSettings` from @columenlabs/lumen-ui, the Send test action now reports why the server refused a send, such as "Sender is not same as SMTP authenticate username", instead of only "The server answered 500".

takeaways.title: Error bodies are read for `message`, then `error`
takeaways.body: When a send fails, the email sending function now reads the API's error body and uses its `message` field, or `error` if there is no `message`, so you can fix a mail setup without digging through server logs.

takeaways.title: Reasons stay short and readable
takeaways.body: The appended reason is cut to a single line of up to 200 characters and shown as "The server answered 500: …", so a long or multi-line error body won't flood the Send test result.

takeaways.title: The assistant knows its tier and model
takeaways.body: In `createAssistant` from `@columenlabs/lumen-ai/assistant`, the main tier's rules now state the tier, the model and its provider, so the assistant can answer when asked what it runs on instead of saying it can't see the model name.

takeaways.title: `#` refs define what "this" means
takeaways.body: In an assistant built with `createAssistant`, a part the person points at with `#` is now what "this" refers to in their message.

takeaways.title: `#` refs limit what gets changed
takeaways.body: In an assistant built with `createAssistant`, when the person asks for a change and has pointed at a part with `#`, that part is the only one the assistant changes, while it still reads the page, other records and its tools for context.

takeaways.title: Let people request more allowance on shared keys
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ai/assistant`, the new `allowance` option on `createAssistant` lets an app set the unit, period, starter amount, offered amounts, approvers and notifications for requests, and the kit handles the rest.

takeaways.title: Request and approve over HTTP
takeaways.body: `createAssistant` now serves `POST /allowance/request` with `{amount, why}`, and for approvers `GET /allowance/requests` and `POST /allowance/requests/:id` with `{action: "grant" | "decline", amount?}`.

takeaways.title: See allowance state in the assistant status
takeaways.body: `AssistantStatus.allowance` (an `AllowanceState`) now tells you what the person has in the app's unit: total, used and left, their newest request, the amounts the form offers, and whether they can approve.

takeaways.title: Drop allowance into settings pages
takeaways.body: Pass `allowance: true` to `assistantSettingsSections` to add an Allowance section with a Request more form, or to `assistantAdminSections` to add an Allowance requests list for approvers.

takeaways.title: Show approvers who is asking
takeaways.body: Pass the new `Caller.label`, such as an email, and approvers will see each request under that label.

takeaways.title: Plan sign-in helpers are now public
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ai/assistant`, you can import `startChatgpt`, `finishChatgpt`, `refreshChatgpt`, `staleChatgpt`, `testChatgpt`, `CHATGPT_REDIRECT`, `CHATGPT_RESOURCE` and `SigninError` to run the plan sign-in flow in an app without mounting the whole assistant.

takeaways.title: Standalone sign-in row
takeaways.body: `@columenlabs/lumen-ui` now exports `LumenChatgptSignin`, which takes `state`, `start`, `finish`, `signOut` and `test` props, so an app that keeps its own tokens can drop in the same sign-in row the assistant uses.

takeaways.title: Assistant reuses the shared component
takeaways.body: The Model providers section of the assistant now renders `LumenChatgptSignin` instead of its own private copy, so the assistant and your app share one sign-in UI.

takeaways.title: Answers no longer cut off
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ai`, the answer round now reads the raw stream events and takes the answer from the completed, incomplete or failed event, so plans that send extra event types no longer end with "Something went wrong while answering".

takeaways.title: Copy from the assistant
takeaways.body: In `@columenlabs/lumen-ui`, `LumenAssistant` now has a Copy icon on each turn, a **Copy chat** action in the header and a `/copy` command for the last turn, all copying Markdown.

takeaways.title: Point at anything with `#`
takeaways.body: In the `LumenAssistant` composer, the `#` list now always opens and offers this page, every `LumenLayout` card on screen, every marked section and a **Point at something…** picker.

takeaways.title: Mark your own sections
takeaways.body: Add `data-assistant-section` (with optional `data-assistant-kind` and `data-assistant-id`) to any element in an app and it appears in the `#` list for the assistant to point at.

takeaways.title: More room for pointed-at text
takeaways.body: The prompt's cap on pointed-at text rises from 8k to 16k characters, so larger cards and sections reach the assistant in full.

takeaways.title: Meter every request from one mount point
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ops/hono`, add the `requestMeter()` middleware to your Hono app and it writes one data point for each answered request, with the route template, status, outcome code, caller, region, bytes, upstream time and subrequest count.

takeaways.title: Meter upstream calls, webhooks, syncs and sign-ins
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ops/events`, call `meterEvent()` for each event, pass `upstream: true` to add its time to the current request, and use `setEventSink(sink, { app, env, version })` to set defaults that every event carries.

takeaways.title: Collect browser telemetry safely
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ops/client`, `meterClientBatch()` checks a batch sent by the browser against a zod schema that allows only enums, templates, codes and numbers, then writes it.

takeaways.title: Flag oversized query results
takeaways.body: In the query meters of `@columenlabs/lumen-ops`, `setQueryRowCap(n)` marks any statement that returns more than `n` rows as `capped` in a new `blob11` column, which is appended so existing columns are unchanged.

takeaways.title: Shared-key controls moved out of the person's settings
takeaways.body: `assistantSettingsSections` from `@columenlabs/lumen-ui/assistant` no longer includes shared-key controls, so an app that used them there must add `assistantAdminSections({ client })` to its admin settings.

takeaways.title: Admin section for shared model keys
takeaways.body: `assistantAdminSections({ client })`, exported from `@columenlabs/lumen-ui/assistant`, returns a "Shared model keys" section where an admin sets each provider's shared key and the per-person monthly allowance.

takeaways.title: Plan sign-in no longer refused
takeaways.body: The provider plan sign-in in `@columenlabs/lumen-ai` now sends its agent host id as `urn:uuid:<uuid>` instead of random base64url, so the authorize page accepts the request.

takeaways.title: Model providers shows only the person's own key
takeaways.body: The Model providers section from `assistantSettingsSections` now shows one row per provider with the person's own key (or the plan sign-in), and the "Pay with first" choice is gone.

takeaways.title: Slash commands in the assistant composer
takeaways.body: In `LumenComposer` from @columenlabs/lumen-ui, typing `/` lists commands (the kit ships /compact, /clear, /model and /escalate), and you can add your own on the server with `createAssistant({ commands: [{ name, about, args?, prompt }] })` or in the browser with the panel's `commands` prop, where `run` executes client-side.

takeaways.title: Pick a tier per message with @
takeaways.body: In `LumenComposer`, typing `@` chooses a tier for a single message, sent as `AssistantMessage.tier`; a higher tier hands the message off, while the same or a lower tier answers it as the main tier.

takeaways.title: Point the assistant at things with #
takeaways.body: In `LumenComposer`, `#` attaches the panel's `sources`, a page's own sources registered with `useAssistantSource`, or the highlighted page text (mark regions with `data-assistant-where`) as chips that are sent as `refs`, and `composeAssistant({ refs, text, tier })` opens the panel with chips and text already filled in.

takeaways.title: Write access with Undo
takeaways.body: `ASSISTANT_ACCESS` now includes `write`, offered only for a `ToolGroup` with `writes: true`, and if you set `undo(caller, { tool, args, result })` each write step in the chat gets an Undo button backed by `AssistantAdapter.undoWrite`.

takeaways.title: Assistant client and chat hook
takeaways.body: From `@columenlabs/lumen-ui/assistant`, `assistantClient(base)` talks to the routes of `@columenlabs/lumen-ai/assistant`, and `useAssistantChat` turns the streamed answer into chat items, so an app can show answers as they arrive with a Stop button, queue a message while an answer runs, open an older chat, and Save or Dismiss a draft.

takeaways.title: Assistant panel and composer
takeaways.body: `LumenAssistant` renders the whole conversation (tool steps, markdown text, draft cards, hand-off, advice, and stopped and error lines) and `LumenComposer` is the input box, so you can drop a full assistant chat into an app without building the UI yourself.

takeaways.title: Assistant dock for the shell
takeaways.body: `useLumenAssistantDock(client, { name })` returns the header button and the docked panel, which you pass to LumenShell's `headerActions` and `panel` props to get a ⌘J toggle and an unread dot.

takeaways.title: Assistant Settings sections
takeaways.body: `assistantSettingsSections({ client, name })` returns ready-made Settings sections for the assistant, model providers, models, tools, web access and spend, so an app can let people and admins configure the assistant without writing those screens.

takeaways.title: Phone bottom sheets can always be dismissed
takeaways.body: In `Sheet` from @columenlabs/lumen-ui, a phone's bottom sheet now stops 44px short of the top so a tap on the dimmed page closes it. It also has a built-in grab handle (swipe down past 80px or flick to close, a shorter drag springs back) and always shows its X, even with `showCloseButton={false}`.

takeaways.title: Close popups with the phone back button
takeaways.body: The new `useBackClose` hook, exported from @columenlabs/lumen-ui, is wired into the `Sheet`, `Dialog` and `AlertDialog` roots, so phone back closes them with no extra props.
